featured.headline: Pentagon report claims zero civilian deaths in boat strikes, watchdogs cry whitewash
featured.dek: A new Defense Department report absolves the U.S. military of civilian casualties in boat strikes — a conclusion independent investigators and critics call a deliberate cover-up spanning multiple administrations.
